title: add-transactional-downgrade-guard-backup-restore-version-pinning-private-installer
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds transactional downgrade guard and automated backup/verify workflows for Private installer; pins chart/operator images during upgrades; introduces idempotent schema migrations and rollback helpers. No breaking API changes to control plane; operational changes affect installer workflow.
description:
Motivation: During a recent Private deployment upgrade (ENG-2345) a partial schema migration caused an unrecoverable downgrade path and required manual intervention. This PR introduces a transactional downgrade guard and improves backup/restore and version-pinning tooling across the installer, Helm charts, and Terraform modules so future upgrades have automated safety checks and reversible paths.

Summary of changes: checklist and high-level approach:
- Add pre-upgrade backup-and-verify job (helm hook + terraform runbook) that asserts a consistent DB snapshot and verifies logical integrity
- Add transactional schema migration wrappers so migrations are either fully applied or an automatic rollback is triggered
- Introduce a downgrade guard: upgrade metadata (cataloged in the version table) prevents applying a newer schema on older binaries; installer will refuse downgrade unless a verified restore path is provided
- Pin chart and operator images used by the installer during upgrade windows to avoid implicit image drift affecting rollback compatibility
- Add CLI tooling: "installer rollback-verify" to dry-run downgrade verification against a backup snapshot
- Add unit/e2e upgrade tests and docs for operators/SEs

Checklist (completed):
- [x] Pre-upgrade backup job and verification scripts
- [x] Transactional wrapper for migration runner (with savepoint semantics)
- [x] Version table and chart value pinning support
- [x] Terraform module changes to ensure postgres snapshots and IAM permissions
- [x] Helm hooks for pre-upgrade and post-rollback verification
- [x] Unit tests for migration runner and CLI flags
- [x] End-to-end upgrade/downgrade test in perf-canary harness
- [x] Docs: private-installer/UPGRADES.md and runbook snippets

Testing performed:
- Local integration: executed full upgrade and automated restore against a 3-node Postgres replica set using the new backup-verify script
- Canary cluster: ran staged upgrade (canary -> partial -> roll-forward) with 3 simulated tenants; exercised rollback flow and verified application-level traffic resumed after restore
- CI: unit tests and helm lint run; e2e upgrade tests executed in perf-canary pipeline

Risks and mitigation:
- Risk: backup verification could give false positives if logical corruption is subtle. Mitigation: verification includes schema checksums and sample-row hashes along with WAL-based replay validation.
- Risk: pinning images increases patching overhead. Mitigation: pins only during the upgrade window and values accept a controlled "allow-image-bump" flag for emergency patches.

Operational notes:
- New commands: `installer backup --verify`, `installer rollback-verify --backup <snapshot>`
- Operators should add the `upgrade-guard` flag to their Helm release during maintenance windows to enable stricter checks.

Related: ENG-2345 (root cause), ENG-2401 (runbook and canary test).
